section Colour Description
text Colour Name
number Colour ID
checkbox Transparent Colour (Editor Only)

section Colour
picker Base ColourPicker
desc Select a main solid colour with the picker above.
number Base Colour R value
number Base Colour G value
number Base Colour B value

section Light Position
picker ColourPicker
desc Position a light source using the TEXT BOXES BELOW.
desc Light position values are from 0 to 255 with:
desc Red equals left-right location, 0 = extreme left and 255 = extreme right
desc Green equals front-back location, 0 = extreme back and 255 = extreme front
desc Blue equals top-bottom location, 0 = extreme top and 255 = extreme bottom
desc RECOMMENDED start values of 70, 255, 0 which positions the light at left side, front, above 
number Colour R value
number Colour G value
number Colour B value

end of form
